name: RadioGOLDINdex (J. David Goldin Discography)
operator: J. David Goldin (Golden Age of Radio / UMKC Marr Partner)

pricing.billingNote: Free web reference lookup; multi-volume PDF/print editions sold separately.
pricing.freeTierNote: Full online text lookup of ~100,000 broadcast entries.

provenance.primaryMasterSource: Direct physical inspection of 95,000+ 16" ET discs and master tapes in the J. David Goldin Collection (now at UMKC Marr)
provenance.airdateMethodology: Transcribed directly from physical studio transcription disc labels, matrix etchings, and audition logs
provenance.castAttributionMethod: Exhaustive actor, announcer, director, writer, and musician credits verified by ear and disc label

specNotes.lossless_et: Text-only discography (0 playable audio streams hosted online).

primary_source_verification.summary: Dates, networks, sponsors, and AFRS/matrix numbers are transcribed directly from physical 16" transcription disc labels.
primary_source_verification.evidenceQuote: "Every entry in RadioGOLDINdex reflects a recording physically auditioned and cataloged by J. David Goldin from disc labels and audio."

cast_credit_accuracy.summary: Unmatched documentation of supporting character actors, announcers, organists, and writers per broadcast.
cast_credit_accuracy.evidenceQuote: "Cross-indexes tens of thousands of supporting actors, announcers, musical directors, and writers across 100,000+ broadcasts."

vtt_transcripts.summary: Text discography only; contains concise 1-sentence loglines, not spoken transcripts.
vtt_transcripts.evidenceQuote: "Provides a brief one-line plot & sponsor note per broadcast; no full-text scripts or .vtt captions."

master_provenance.summary: Documents exact transcription service ( syndicated Ziv, Lang-Worth, World, NBC Orthacoustic, AFRS) and disc numbers.
master_provenance.evidenceQuote: "Lists transcription syndicate, sustaining vs. sponsored status, and physical Goldin catalog numbers."

serial_continuity.summary: Chronological series listings clearly trace sequential episode numbers and audition pressings.
serial_continuity.evidenceQuote: "Ordered strictly by broadcast date and episode/matrix sequence within each program page."

open_api_export.summary: Static 1990s HTML pages (`f1.html`, `f2.html`) with no JSON API, no search endpoint, and no `/llms.txt`.
open_api_export.evidenceQuote: "Generated as static alphabetical HTML files from a legacy desktop database with no REST API."

ad_free_playback.summary: Cannot stream or play audio — text-only reference index.
ad_free_playback.evidenceQuote: "RadioGOLDINdex is a text reference database only; it does not stream or sell audio recordings."

dedup_integrity.summary: Clearly separates original network broadcasts from AFRS re-uses and syndicated re-titles.
dedup_integrity.evidenceQuote: "Explicitly notes when an AFRS or syndicated pressing reuses an earlier network broadcast."

gotchas.title: Zero Audio Playback or Downloads (0% Streamable)
gotchas.detail: RadioGOLDINdex is strictly a discographical text encyclopedia. Users looking to actually listen to the broadcasts must cross-reference them on RadioIndex or visit UMKC Marr.

gotchas.title: Static Alphabetical HTML Frames Without Query Engine
gotchas.detail: Cannot run compound queries (e.g., 'all CBS broadcasts from October 1948 featuring William Conrad') without downloading and parsing thousands of static HTML files.
